title: Understanding the Graph
text: The graph shows the relationship between temperature and tip amount. The line represents the fitted least squares regression model.

title: Identifying Data Points
text: Identify the three data points on the graph. These are the actual observations used to fit the regression line.

title: Calculating Residuals
text: For each data point, calculate the residual, which is the difference between the observed tip and the predicted tip from the regression line.

title: Formula for MSE
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is calculated as the average of the squared residuals.

title: Compute Residuals
text: Calculate the residuals for each data point. If the observed tip is $$30$$ and the predicted tip is $$28$$, the residual is $$30-28$$.

title: Calculate Squared Residuals
text: Square each residual. If the residual is $$2$$, the squared residual is $$2^2$$.

title: Compute MSE
text: Sum the squared residuals and divide by the number of observations to find the MSE.
